item: w8_flat_planes_couples_v5 (initial-scope stdlib FLOAT exploration; evidence only, never a proof premise)
admission: initial scope: frozen <=300 s stdlib probe, single process, <=256 MiB RSS, <=16 MiB output; no numpy/native
purpose: v3 and v4 (same 130 planes) gave different exotic-exotic compatible counts per basis: record lambda_1, lambda_2 and unitary defect of every couple test involving an exotic plane, and re-scan K4 with a relaxed compatibility rule, to see whether the 'no all-exotic K4 assignment' outcome is threshold-sensitive.
wrapper: /bin/bash -c 'echo START date PID $$ PGID; exec /usr/bin/env -i TMPDIR=<lane>/tmp <argv>' (exec keeps the PID)
